facts.fact: CGA Advogados says Decreto-Lei 1/2024 of 8 March 2024 makes beneficial owner declarations registrable at the Conservatoria do Registo das Entidades Legais, due by 6 June 2024, and that they can now be filed remotely on its submission portal, though final approval on the portal was still being harmonised.
facts.system: Conservatoria do Registo das Entidades Legais (CREL) submission portal
